data.name: Corn.Monolog
data.value: Hey! What?! Who drank the beer from your mug? The dark, thick one with that fresh foam you just can't resist? I can't even imagine! It definitely wasn't me. But here's a little gift for you anyway. *[Brings you a bundle of straw]* Just in case. And definitely not because I'm trying to make up for something I totally didn't do.

data.name: SheepCorn.Monolog
data.value: Why so serious? The pleasure is to play, it makes no difference what you say I don't share your greed, the only card I need is The Ace of Spades
